title: Aromatic Smoky Australian Fennel Roast
description: A light and crispy Australian dish featuring fennel seeds and a smoky flavor, perfect for a low-calorie dinner option. This recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together toasted fennel seeds, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken breast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the sliced chicken and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
